svg.title: One index or two
svg.desc: With Paperless Unified Search there is one index. Nextcloud's search asks Paperless-ngx, whose OCR and full-text index already holds the words of every document, and each document that matches opens its synchronized file in Nextcloud. With a search of its own in Nextcloud, such as Full text search with Elasticsearch, Context Chat or Findling, there are two. The synchronized files are read again, scans are recognized again, and their words are stored a second time, in an index with a server or a container of its own, which Nextcloud's search asks instead.
